title: DEFINE step 3 PR 6: D4 closed-set and ownerRef findings, D5 catalogue, standards citation on the gates module
description: src/query/gates.js grows four new engineer checks: stories:closedSets (over delta; AC description with an enumeration cue and no bracketed list or ownerRef fails, honouring the quoted-cue guard shared with D6); stories:ownerRefResolves (over delta plus tree for ownerRef targets; every ownerRef { tacId, field: interfaces[<name>] } on an AC resolves on that TAC, else fails with 'ownerRef does not resolve'); crosscut:catalogue (over tree; for every REQ in scope, every applicable (reqShape, concern) pair via src/define/concern-catalogue.js has a concern-ledger entry keyed <REQ>:<concern> with disposition applied or waived, else fails <REQ>:<concern>); skeleton:standardsCited (over tree; every manifest.standards[].slug is cited in a REQ rationale or an ADR, or waived by a concern-ledger entry keyed standards:<pack>, else fails standards:<pack> with 'uncited and unwaived'). The CHECK_PERSONA and CHECK_QUESTION maps grow in step. parseAcClass is already exported; closedSets re-uses the quoted-cue guard pattern.
